value.rationale: A canonical first cyclic complete-tripartite feedback case answers a small, sharply motivated instance of Deshpande–Sawant 2026 Problem 6.3. Its three positive homology degrees, free integral groups, and simply-connectedness are not implied by the S2 homotopy of the unconstrained local-degree join; all are established by a compact replayable certificate.
